privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service state training use of both inputs and outputs is mandatory with no opt-out: 'You acknowledge and agree that we may use your Input Content and any Output to train or otherwise improve our Services, including our artificial intelligence and machine learnings model(s) related to the Services.' The content license grant is described as 'royalty free, fully paid-up, transferable, sub-licensable, assignable, worldwide, perpetual and irrevocable.' No tiered opt-out (Free/Standard/Pro) is mentioned anywhere in the Terms or Privacy Policy. Note: Udio is also the subject of active musician/rightsholder litigation (e.g. Illinois biometric-privacy suit and copyright class actions against Uncharted Labs) alleging training on copyrighted recordings and voiceprints without consent -- this is public litigation, not a vendor admission, and is flagged for awareness rather than graded as a cert.
privacy.data_region: United States. Privacy Policy states: 'The Services are hosted and operated in the United States ... you authorize the Company to transfer, store and process your information to and in the U.S., and possibly other countries. In some circumstances, your Personal Data may be transferred to the U.S. pursuant to a data processing agreement incorporating standard data protection clauses.'

security.name: Payment handling

security.name: Do Not Track / GPC
security.value: "Please note that because of our use of Cookies, the Services do not support 'Do Not Track' requests sent from a browser at this time." Global Privacy Control (GPC) is honored for opt-out of sale/share/targeted advertising per the Privacy Policy's opt-out section.

products.name: Udio Free
products.data_scope: Account profile/contact data, device/IP data, web analytics, uploaded Input Content (prompts, lyrics, optional audio files); no payment data collected
products.notes: 10 credits/day, 100 credits/month, 3 full-length (2:10) song generations per day. Input/Output used for AI training per ToS; no opt-out.

products.name: Udio Standard
products.data_scope: Same as Free plus payment data (via Stripe) and any uploaded reference audio/cover art
products.notes: $8-10/month. Adds voice control, lyric/music editing, audio-file uploads, style reference from existing songs. Same training terms apply as Free tier.

products.name: Udio Pro
products.category: Consumer AI music generation (top paid tier)
products.notes: $24-30/month, highest generation limits. No enterprise/business tier, no team seats, no API, no admin/SSO controls found.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium consumer subscription (Free / Standard ~$8-10mo / Pro ~$24-30mo) plus a la carte credit packs; no enterprise or usage-based API pricing published
compare.data_residency: United States (vendor-stated); international transfers governed by standard contractual clauses per Privacy Policy

flags: No trust center, security page, or third-party audit/certification of any kind found on udio.com or unchartedlabs.ai; /security path redirects to login rather than a security page -- normal for a small consumer startup but means all security claims are unverifiable beyond generic Privacy Policy language.

Mandatory AI training on user Input Content and Output with no opt-out, and a perpetual/irrevocable/sublicensable license grant over user content -- should be disclosed prominently to any AIFOXX visitor considering uploading original audio.

Uncharted Labs, Inc. (Udio) is named in active third-party litigation (a 2025 Illinois class action alleging unlicensed biometric voiceprint collection, and copyright infringement suits from major labels/artists over training data) -- these are unresolved public legal allegations, not confirmed facts, and are not a substitute for a security/compliance assessment, but are material context for a listing.

No DPA (Data Processing Agreement) or Business Associate Agreement is offered or referenced for customers -- appropriate for a B2C tool but means Udio is not suited for any use case requiring contractual data-processing terms.

Identity check: confirmed the operating entity is Uncharted Labs, Inc. d/b/a udio.com (per Terms of Service masthead and litigation captions), not to be confused by name similarity with any other 'Udio'/'Uncharted' branded companies.
